subject: POC: Convert remaining hours to burst capacity - proposal
messages:
From: Sara O'Neal <sara@needle.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: michael.lin@needle.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap + ask: convert leftover hours to burst capacity?

Hi Hannah,

Quick note as our POC approaches the scheduled end date (2026-07-09). We ran our stress suite last week and saw a few short windows where we need high concurrency for short bursts — roughly 400-600 vCPU-equivalent minutes across a handful of tests.

Current usage: ~60/200 reserved hours consumed. We don't want to extend the timebox by a full two weeks if we can avoid it, but we would find it very helpful to convert the remaining hours or an agreed portion into "burst credits" we can consume in short, high-throughput runs. That would let us validate scale without paying for a longer continuous reservation.

Attached is our June usage breakdown (needle_usage_Jun2026.csv) and a short note on the tests we still need to run. Two questions:
1) Can Redwood convert unused pilot hours to burst credits for hosted inference?
2) If so, what is the rate and cap (and are credits usable across dedicated/private deployments)?

We'd prefer a quick, simple amendment rather than a multi-step addendum. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call.

Thanks,
Sara O'Neal
Product Manager, Needle.ai

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Sara O'Neal <sara@needle.ai>, Michael Lin <michael.lin@needle.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + ask: convert leftover hours to burst capacity?

Sara — thanks for the usage file and the clear ask. We can definitely put together two practical paths; I'll outline them here so we can pick quickly: 

Option A — Short extension (timebox): add 2 weeks to the current pilot, same scope. We can offer a 30% credit on the pro-rated timebox fee for the extension. This preserves the current reservation model and keeps billing straightforward.

Option B — Convert unused hours to burst credits (preferred for your use-case): convert X of your unused hours into burst credits you can redeem for high-concurrency runs in hosted Redwood. For Needle.ai I propose converting up to 120 hours into burst credits with a 1.4x uplift factor (i.e., credits purchased at 40% premium vs. equivalent reserved hours) to account for on-demand capacity. Credits will be consumable only on the hosted tier (not on dedicated or private without a separate agreement). We'll cap single-burst consumption to 500 concurrent inference slots to protect the shared pool.

Operational notes:
- We can enact Option B immediately with a short amendment (no DocuSign for low-dollar changes) or do a formal SOW amendment if your procurement needs it.
- I'll need Jordan on the thread for pricing approval and Marissa for CS to scope any integration work for the bursts.

If you confirm Option B I will draft the amendment and a Quote PDF and loop in finance for invoice timing.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, Sara O'Neal <sara@needle.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + ask: convert leftover hours to burst capacity?

Agree with Hannah — Option B is the right experience for validation. A couple of things from pricing/ops:
- Proposed commercial: convert up to 120 hours -> burst credits at 1.4x (agreed) but set a soft cap of 500 burst-consumption-hours per 24h period. We should also include a hard cap total equal to 120 hours converted.
- Billing: we'll issue a one-time invoice for the uplifted amount. Revenue recognized when credits are invoiced; credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- For procurement comfort we can provide a short amendment (1 page) + a Quote PDF — DocuSign only if Needle procurement insists.

Marissa: can your team confirm there are no engineering blockers to enabling short-lived burst slots for Needle's current pilot instance?

Jordan Blake
Director, Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference

From: Sara O'Neal <sara@needle.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Lin <michael.lin@needle.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + ask: convert leftover hours to burst capacity?

Thanks Hannah/Jordan — Option B sounds good in principle. A few clarifications before we sign: 
1) Can you confirm credits are only for hosted? (We are evaluating a dedicated slash private deployment later in the year; credits to be used there would require a separate commercial conversation).
2) Expiry of 90 days is acceptable.
3) We have internal procurement thresholds — will need a signed amendment or a PO for any invoice > $5k. If the uplifted amount is under that, quick amendment by email is fine.

We are comfortable with the 1.4x uplift and the 120-hour conversion cap. Please send the Quote and the one-page amendment. We'll review and get a PO in short order if it exceeds our internal threshold.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Michael and I can sign-off once we have the Quote.

Sara

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Sara O'Neal <sara@needle.ai>, Michael Lin <michael.lin@needle.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + ask: convert leftover hours to burst capacity? — Quote & amendment attached

Sara / Michael — attaching the short amendment and the quote PDF for the burst conversion. Summary below and next steps: 

What we are offering (final):
- Convert up to 120 unused pilot hours into Burst Credits for hosted Redwood only.
- Price: 1.4x uplift on equivalent reserved-hour rate = USD 4,200 (one-time invoice).
- Soft cap: 500 burst-consumption-hours / 24h period. Hard cap: 120 total converted hours.
- Credits expire 90 days after invoice date.

Attachments: amended_sow_hours-to-burst.pdf (1-page amendment); burst_credit_quote_needle_20260707.pdf (quote & invoice preview). Also includes your uploaded usage file as reference.

Next steps:
1) If invoice <= $5k — reply with confirmation and we will send invoice and apply credits upon payment.
2) If invoice > $5k — we will send a DocuSign amendment for signature.
3) Marissa will ping-engineering to provision burst slots once payment is received.

If that all looks right I'll mark deal RDW-DEAL-2026-129 as "pilot-burst-converted" in HubSpot and route a one-time invoice.

Thanks — will stand by for your confirmation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
